target_customer: Job seekers in India who pay a share of salary after placement; hiring partner companies
problem: Aspiring tech workers in India, including women and unemployed youth, could not afford upfront bootcamp fees, and employers needed trained engineers.
business_model: Income share agreement bootcamp: students pay a share of salary after placement (a 2022 report says 17 percent of monthly salary for 36 months)

founders.name: Bharat Gupta
founders.background_notes: Growth head at Paytm's consumer internet business, per the YC page.

founders.name: Pritesh Kumar
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder by the YC page and Preqin; technical status inferred from role not stated, so left as listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: A bootcamp is a curriculum and placement operation; technology was a learning platform with little engineering difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: ISA bootcamps in India were multiplying (Masai, Newton, Pesto), and a brand and employer network were the only edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors kept operating; the acquirer of FunctionUp is not identified by a reliable source.

market_need_then: Indian edtech demand for upskilling was high in 2020 and 2021, and the founders cited a gap in affordable placement-linked training; no sourced spend data was found.

rebrands.why: The legal entity is FanPlay Games and Media Private Limited, so the company appears to have changed from a gaming brand to an edtech brand; reason and date not sourced

brand_strength.rationale: Local press coverage in YourStory (2022) but no evidence of brand-driven growth.

pivots.from: FanPlay gaming company (inferred from entity name and an unrelated Fanplay funding result)

outcome_analysis: FunctionUp ran an income share agreement bootcamp in India and is listed as acquired by YC, but no reliable source names the buyer, date or price. A 2023 Inc42 cap table showed the parent FanPlay Inc holding 83.9 percent, so the exit may be a parent or related party deal. Too little is public to assign causes.
notes: functionup.org returned HTTP 522 on fetch. Funding unverified: Seedtable says $1.5M from Goodwater, Y Combinator, LetsVenture and Core91 (June 2021), Extruct says $0.1M, Preqin says undisclosed from Paipal Ventures. These conflict, so no round recorded. Seedtable acquisition date of 2024-05-30 appears on an unrelated Classplus page, so not used. Competitor sources are from 2022, after the 2021 batch, and are the nearest dated evidence; no 2021 source found. The Fanplay gaming funding result (a $12M pre-Series A) was not confirmed as the same entity and is excluded. Scaler Academy and Newton School were named as rivals in a July 2022 YourStory article (after the batch), so they are not listed as competitors at founding.
